source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: BBA集体大降价：宝马5系跌至28万
topics.official_english: German luxury carmakers cut prices, BMW 5 Series drops to 280,000 yuan
topics.why_hot: A rare across-the-board price cut by BBA brands makes a top-selling sedan more affordable and reignites debate over how legacy automakers will cope with competition in China's auto market.
topics.share_angle: Explain who is cutting prices, what it signals for the auto market, and why it matters for consumers deciding between fuel and electric cars.

topics.official_english: Durian prices see sharp fall in China
topics.why_hot: A big fall in durian prices catches shoppers' attention and raises questions about supply, import competition, and whether the 'king of fruits' is becoming an everyday treat.
topics.share_angle: Break down why durian prices dropped and what it says about China's fruit imports and consumer spending.

topics.chinese_topic: 石油天然气发展“十五五”规划印发
topics.official_english: China issues 15th Five-Year Plan for oil and natural gas development
topics.why_hot: A new national plan for oil and gas development sets the direction for energy policy over the next five years, making it a key story for energy security and climate policy.
topics.share_angle: Simplify the plan's main points and explain how China is balancing fossil fuel supply with clean-energy goals.

topics.chinese_topic: 块9包邮的手机壳还敢买吗

topics.why_hot: The phrase '9.9 yuan with free shipping' is everywhere, but consumers wonder how sellers keep prices so low and whether quality and safety are being sacrificed.
topics.share_angle: Use this everyday product to explain ultra-low-cost e-commerce, product safety, and how to read between the lines of bargain prices.

topics.official_english: Several AI-generated comic dramas suspend updates
topics.why_hot: News that multiple AI comic series are stopping updates at the same time raises questions about the future of AI-generated content and the stability of this new creative format.
topics.share_angle: Look at why platforms may be pulling AI comics and what it means for creators, viewers, and the AI boom.
